name: Kate & Allie
description: Kate & Allie is an American television situation comedy which ran from March 19, 1984, to May 22, 1989. Kate & Allie first aired on CBS as a midseason replacement series and only six episodes were initially commissioned, but the favorable response from critics and viewers alike easily convinced CBS to commit to a full season in the fall of 1984. The series was created by Sherry Coben.

videos.title: The Trouble With Jason

Jennie advises Jason to back off a little, but he shows up again with flowers -- for Jennie.

videos.overview: Kate and Allie find a wallet containing $5,000 in cash, and the grateful owner gives them a $500 reward -- so Kate challenges Allie to spend her half on something frivolous she will enjoy.

videos.title: The Bully
videos.overview: Chip's scrapes are not all due to baseball: he's being bullied at school, but is embarrassed to admit that his tormentor is an apparently sweet little girl.

videos.title: General Hospital
videos.overview: Kate's surprise birthday party is delayed while she recuperates in hospital, so Allie checks in to keep her company.

videos.title: Rx for Love
videos.overview: His bedside manner's irresistible, so Kate's in love...

videos.title: Halloween II
videos.overview: The kids plan a Hallowe'en haunting -- and so do their mothers.

videos.title: Jennie and Jason
videos.overview: Jennie's boyfriend is pressing her to go all the way, so it looks like time for the dreaded mother-daughter conversation.

videos.overview: Allie gives Charles a lecture on responsibility when Chip and Jenny feel he has abandoned them for his new family, but Allie discovers that Clare and baby Stuart aren't seeing much of him either.

videos.title: Emma's Coming Out Party
videos.overview: Kate and Allie recall their most famous fight, seventeen years ago -- during which Kate went into labour.

videos.title: Stage Mother
videos.overview: Jennie gets a chance to sing on cable tv -- if she can leap the hurdle of Allie's excessive enthusiasm.

videos.title: The Goodbye Girl
videos.overview: Allie and her boss Eddie are stranded in the studio by a blizzard -- and must keep the show on the air.

videos.title: Dates of Future Past
videos.overview: While Kate's away on a business trip, an ex-football player makes a play for Allie.

videos.title: Gift of the Magi
videos.overview: Kate and Allie buy each other third-anniversary gifts, but with an O. Henry twist: Allie pawns her camera to buy a shade for Kate's antique lamp, while Kate sells the lamp to buy Allie a camera lens.

videos.title: Allie's Graduation
videos.overview: Allie triumphantly graduates from college, but learns that a diploma isn't necessarily a ticket to the job of her choice.

videos.title: Upstairs, Downstairs
videos.overview:
Jennie arranges a date for Emma.

Kate and Allie interfere in Jennie and Emma's latest spat.

videos.title: Emma Goes to College
videos.overview: Emma has to decide between going to college at Columbia or UCLA.

videos.title: Allie and the Three Wolves
videos.overview: At a singles bar, Allie becomes the target of a bet between three men on the prowl.

videos.title: Louis in Love
videos.overview:
Kate tries to explain love to Louis.

The family meet Louis' mentally challenged friend Catherine, who clearly has a crush on him, so Kate tries to persuade Louis that a woman really likes him and he assumes she means herself.

videos.title: Reruns
videos.overview:
Allie dreams that she and Kate are characters in ""I Love Lucy.""

Mail forwarded to Allie from Connecticut contains a perfumed envelope addressed to Charles, marked ""Private and Personal"". Struggling to keep from opening it, Allie falls asleep in front of late night TV and dreams herself and Kate into old episodes of ""I Love Lucy"" and ""Mary Tyler Moore.""

videos.title: Send Me No Flowers
videos.overview: The arrival of a bouquet with a card saying simply ""I'm sorry"" prompts everyone to recount how badly they were treated that day -- by clerks, bank personnel, schoolmates -- and to speculate on who exactly is apologizing to whom.

videos.title: Dearly Beloved
videos.overview:
To dig up enough money for a date, Chip opens a pet cemetery.

To finance a date, Chip starts a pet-burial service.

videos.title: Allie on Strike
videos.overview: Fed up with constant demands from the kids and Kate, feeling overworked and unappreciated, Allie goes ""on strike"" -- then gets worried when the others start to cope without her.

videos.title: Kate Quits
videos.overview: Emma asks Kate to talk about her work as a travel agent for her school's ""Women's Career Day,"" causing Allie to realize how much she hates her job at the movie theatre -- until it burns down. When Kate encourages her to find a job she wants, such as the museum job she has always wanted, Allie finds a position in the gift shop of the ""Museum of Contemporary Art"" -- and her happiness causes Kate to realize how much she hates her job. Kate's talk turns into a rant about needing the courage to quit her job & then Allie arrives home to say the Museum's sprinklers causes a flood and she is unemployed too.

videos.title: Charles' Dinner
videos.overview: Kate and Allie cater Charles' and Claire's anniversary dinner.

videos.title: Allie's Surprise Party
videos.overview: Kate and Allie deal with a demanding socialite's children's party, while Allie mopes over turning 39 without a surprise party of her own.

videos.title: Fathers and Sons
videos.overview: An adult Chip brings his son Scotty to the old apartment just before the building is demolished, and reminisces a bout the day he tried to conceal a report card showing that he had failed science -- convincing him that he would always be a failure.

videos.title: The Dilemma with Emma
videos.overview: Everyone has date problems: Emma has no date for the college dance and must go with Jennie and Jason & Jennie breaks up with Jason & Chip has a fight with Amy upstairs because she was drooling over Matt Dillon in the movie they rent ed & Kate's chiropractor date was a self-centered bore; and Allie has no date at all. But Emma meets someone at the dance: a self-satisfied, arrogrant business major whom everyone else hates on sight.

videos.title: Kate and the Cab Driver
videos.overview: Kate falls for a charmingly immature cab driver who quit his job as an advertising executive to become an artist -- and who wants Kate to go on impulse with him to Brazil.

videos.title: Mother's Day
videos.overview: Resenting their daughters' taking them for granted, Kate and Allie guiltily invite their own mothers to lunch -- then regret it when Marion won't stop talking about the food on her recent cruise and Joan won't stop criticizing Allie.

videos.title: Return of Bob Barsky
videos.overview: After an unexplained absence, Bob Barsky calls to ask Allie out on a date and explains that he is moving back to New York -- and is also seeing someone else.

videos.title: Brother, Can You Spare a Dime?
videos.overview: While Kate and Dennis take old clothes to Goodwill, Allie rushes across town to pay Jennie's school fees but l eaves her purse in the cab and is left stranded and penniless in Manhattan.

videos.title: Ted's Fix-Up
videos.overview: Kate and Angela fix each other up with each other's ex's, with surprising results.

videos.title: Jennie's New Deal
videos.overview: After Emma moves into the college dorm, Jennie feels cooped up living at home under her mother's rules.

videos.title: Hired Wife
videos.overview: Businessman Bill Connor comes with a startling proposition: he is single but pretending to be married in order to get a promotion, and needs someone to impersonate his non-existent wife at an executive party. Kate agrees with his stand against prejudice on the basis of marital status but then is attracted to a man who turns out to be a co-worker of Bill's.  The whole farce turns out to be moot when Bill finds out the promotion was never available--the company was hiring from the outside--and quits, leaving Kate free to date Peter.

videos.title: The Marriage Counselor
videos.overview: Bob suggests marriage counseling for the constantly bickering Kate and Allie.

videos.title: The Triangle Has Four Sides
videos.overview: Kate tries to date Dennis and Peter at the same time, but they end up finding out about each other.  When Kate realizes they don't care she is dating other men, she dumps them both and starts dating Ted, again.

videos.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
videos.overview: Kate, Allie and the kids work overtime buying and wrapping gifts for the catering clients, promising themselves a skiing vacation in Vermont & but the apartment is burgled and everything stolen, leaving them to redo it all in just one day.

videos.title: The Band Singer
videos.overview: Jenny is enamored of classmate Howard, auditions for his band, and becomes their lead singer. While the band rehearses in their basement, Kate and Allie give combined French dinners/French lessons and worry that Jenny is not willing to be herself with Howard  -- to the point where she won't admit she can't rollerskate when he wants her to sing dressed as a skating '50s carhop.

videos.title: Almost Married (a.k.a.) And Then There Were None
videos.overview: Ted invites everybody to his friends' cabin in the Adirondacks, but there's an escaped convict on the loose.

videos.title: My Day with Paul Newman
videos.overview: A film crew asks to use the front door in a movie

videos.title: The Namath of the Game
videos.overview: Sports nut Kate becomes Joe Namath's personal assistant

videos.title: The Mouse That Squeaked
videos.overview: Kate and Allie panic when Chip's mouse gets loose.

videos.title: Inside Park Avenue
videos.overview: Kate and Allie get a taste of how the other half lives---and loves---when they cater a society couple's 25th-anniversary party.

videos.title: Working Women
videos.overview: Arrogant businessman Jack Brompton hires the women to cater ""an authentic early American dinner for 24"" at his place in the Hamptons, then repeatedly changes the theme and menu from American Civil War to Victorian England. Jenny's video project on working women for her women's study course prompts fantasy sequences with Kate and Allie as immigrant women in a sweatshop and as WWII factory workers. Inspired to stand up for themselves, they confront Brompton about his shoddy treatment of them -- and discover that he is a henpecked husband only obeying his shrewish wife's whims.

videos.title: I Don't, I Don't
videos.overview: Bob is in a panic because he feels he's not ready for marriage---which no one has mentioned.

videos.title: Bob Smells the Roses
videos.overview: Shaken by a friend's heart attack, Bob decides he should live life to the fullest---with Allie as his wife.  Part 1 of two.

videos.title: Allie Makes Up Her Mind
videos.overview: Conclusion.  Allie can't decide whether to accept Bob's marriage proposal.

videos.title: The Clip Show
videos.overview: The series' 100th episode is celebrated with clips from past shows.

videos.title: Wedding Belle Blues
videos.overview: As the nervous bride-to-be, Allie has nightmares about meeting her fiancÃ©'s parents.

videos.title: Kate Gets Dumped
videos.overview: While honeymooners Allie and Bob fly off to Hawaii, Bob dumps Kate.

videos.title: Allie Doesn't Live Here Anymore
videos.overview: As Allie moves into her new high-rise condo, Kate interviews a potential housemate.

videos.title: The Odd Couples
videos.overview: Kate is saved from perky Haven and Blair when Allie suggests that Kate move in.

videos.title: Anchor Away
videos.overview: Watching a tape of Bob's sportscast, Allie notices an attractive anchor making an on-air play for her husband.

videos.title: Better Never Than Late
videos.overview: Bob's mother questions Allie about having another child.

videos.title: Moving On
videos.overview: Kate spends her 40th birthday wondering what she has done with her life -- and, shaken by Emma's transfer to UCLA, decides to join the Peace Corps.

videos.title: A Tree Grows on West 56th Street
videos.overview: Kate organizes a block association to save a park.

videos.title: The Nearlyweds
videos.overview: Allie's reaction upon hearing that Jennie and her boyfriend are sharing a dorm room doesn't compare with her reaction when they announce they're getting married.

videos.title: Wanted: One Husband
videos.overview: A rich neighbour offers a hefty sum to Kate and Allie if they can find her ""a Bob..""

videos.title: What's Love Got to Do with It?
videos.overview: Kate is dating a man with no charm, looks or personality, yet everyone loves him -- except Kate.

videos.title: I've Got a Secret
videos.overview: Kate has trouble keeping quiet about Bob's broadcasting future.

videos.title: Love Thy Neighbor
videos.overview: Trying to mend a broken romance, Kate feigns love in front of the woman who dumped her neighbor -- but he thinks Kate's serious.

videos.title: Trojan War
videos.overview: Allie discovers a condom in Chip's pocket.

videos.title: Loan-some Bob
videos.overview: Kate and Allie get a loan from Bob.

videos.title: The Review
videos.overview: When Allie's sushi draws a bad review from a critic, Kate determines to please the man's palate to gain a retraction.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Kate reluctantly agrees to accompany Lou to his cousin's wedding.

videos.title: The Last Temptation of Allie
videos.overview: While Allie prepares her entry for Cousin Cabot's Country Cookbook contest, Kate cooks up a way to help Lou.

videos.title: Hockey Team
videos.overview: Bob lets Chip join the hockey team without consulting Allie.

videos.title: My Boyfriend's Back
videos.overview: Allie's ex-boyfriend returns to New York for the opening of his off-Broadway play, which turns out to be based on their romance. Unfortunately for Allie, he has eyes only for Kate.

videos.title: What a Wonderful Episode (a.k.a. It's a Wonderful Episode a.k.a. Kate and Allie Go to Hell)
videos.overview: A job offer and a $2000 check from a man named Gabriel prompt Kate and Allie to take account of their lives.

awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 5 wins & 28 nominations total
